Two ridges: the upper wing's ridge along y = 3.75 (posts at 2'/2'' on S-03, 0.90 apart; S-04 draws the ridge line ~1.00 between the hip intersections) and the lower wing's ridge along x = 3.25 from B''' (4.25) to the post at C' (5.73). Hips and valley are 45-degree diagonals — span_length_m null / unresolved per section 4.

Four member ends sit on points that no chain prints: the lower ridge's north end B''' (4.25), the re-entrant eave corner 3'/D' (7.50 / 8.50) and the east-wing eave corner D'4''. Those grid-master lines were scaled from the vector geometry of this sheet (each carries its own lower confidence there), and the members using them carry a lower confidence_score.
Hip ends at the upper ridge are recorded at the printed ตั้ง post positions 2'/2'' (3.80 / 4.70); the drawn intersections are ~0.05 further out (3.75 / 4.75) — flagged end_snapped_to_post.
Rafter count 46 counted from the drawn solid lines on the vector sheet; purlins are drawn only inside the cut-away detail, so their count is left null.
